[[Eurayle]] sends your [[party]] to [[the Deep]].

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Kaineng Center}} (only appears during Factions Elite [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]])
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|Cavalon}} (he can only be accessed by members of the [[alliance]] that [[Kurzick-Luxon border|controls]] Cavalon)

==Dialogue==
:''"Years ago, when the [[Jade Wind]] froze the sea, a [[demon]] of [[Nightmare Horde|nightmares]] was trapped deep below the sea's hardened waters.  A group of Luxons unearthed the demon's resting place while mining the sea for jade and other resources.  The demon's nightmares slowly seeped into their minds, until they eventually went insane.  The tale of these [[outcast]]s is a sad one, but if you come across any, do not show them pity.  They are beyond rehabilitation and will not hesitate to kill you.''

:''The demon that caused the corruption of these outcasts is known by the name [[Kanaxai]], bringer of despair.  He is also the source of the [[oni]] that appear all over [[Cantha]] as waking nightmares.  If you wish to prove your loyalty to the Luxons, head into the caves known as The Deep that lead toward the ancient mine, and destroy the outcasts and the demon Kanaxai."''
:{{ask|gold}} '''Can you take me to The Deep?'''
::''"Sure, just let me know when you are ready."''
::{{yes|ingame}}''' I am ready.'''
:::''This will take you into The Deep. Once inside, you will be able to reform your party and adjust your [[skill]]s before proceeding. Are you sure you would like to enter The Deep now?''
:::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am sure.''' (sent to [[The Deep (outpost)]])
:::{{No|ingame}} '''Perhaps not.'''
::{{no|ingame}} '''I am not ready.'''
:{{no}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

==Notes==
*Both Eurayle and [[Vash]] enter Kaineng Center from [[Bukdek Byway]] when a player loads into a new instance.
